namingConventions.runId: UTC basic timestamp plus random suffix
namingConventions.freshEvidence: field proof must be created after the current stage start timestamp
namingConventions.statusArtifacts: stable names are allowed only for harness status and operator-command envelope reports; field run artifacts use unique run roots
namingConventions.fixtureIds: lowercase hyphenated synthetic classification; no operator identity or private path

forbidden: Do not commit generated live-cert, technician-ready, exact-head, fleet-state, harness-status, or operator-command envelope evidence.
Do not include credentials, browser tokens, private endpoints, operator usernames, private hostnames, or copied production output in tracked fixtures.
Do not execute or publish copied shell prompts, duplicated prompts, continuation prompts, transcripts, stack traces, or error output as commands.
Do not put expected output or instructional prose inside executable command blocks.
Do not print an expected SHA as verified proof; persist the actual worktree HEAD after equality validation.
Do not treat command-envelope cleanliness or local readiness as command execution success, provider authentication, quota, hosted response, or operator acceptance.
